causes: Inhaling dust contaminated by infected animals (cattle, sheep, goats).

description: Toxicity from excessive quinine intake, historically used to treat malaria.
causes: Overdose of quinine medication or consumption of large amounts of tonic water.
prevention: Follow prescribed dosages, avoid excessive tonic water consumption.
treatment_action: Supportive care, activated charcoal if recent ingestion.
complications: Permanent hearing or vision loss, cardiac arrest.
